target_applications: machine tending, intralogistics transport, reception/service, canteen tasks, education/research

base_type.value: wheeled AMR (ReBeLMove Pro, differential drive, three-point bearing chassis); fixed torso, no lift

torso_lift.value: fixed (no lift column); AMR base carries up to 100 kg (Home variant chassis rated 250 kg)

actuators.value: ReBeL joints: brushless motors with lubrication-free polymer cycloidal gearboxes; joint speed up to 45 deg/s, max joint torque 20 Nm

end_effector.value: bionic hands (igus ReBeL Hand); included: 1x suction pad with CobotPump, 1x ReBeL gripper; Home variant: vacuum/multi-finger/bionic-hand options

media_at_flange.value: vacuum via CobotPump accessory; no other media documented

sensors_head.value: virtual face display; 3D camera in chest area

sensors_base.value: LiDAR, 3D camera in vehicle base, SLAM navigation

software_stack.value: igus Robot Control (iRC, free, 3D simulation); ROS 2 interface; VDA/VDE 5050 fleet interface; web-based no-code mission programming (Home variant); no AI/VLA autonomy stack claimed

safety_compliance.value: CE-certified; VDA/VDE 5050 fleet standard; no ISO 13482 / TS 15066 validation published

price.value: EUR 47,999 (~USD 54,500); iggyRob Home variant price on request

availability.value: catalogue product via igus + RBTX; 'ready to ship from 24 hours' (igus.eu); Home variant ~3 weeks; test-before-you-invest trial program

deployment_evidence.value: no named external customers; igus internal use for injection-molding machine tending planned; live catalogue availability

notes: Two variants: iggyRob (0-LCA-IROB, EUR 47,999, 101 kg, 2 kg/arm) and iggyRob Home (RBTX-IGUS-0353, 120 kg, 2.5 kg/arm, chassis 250 kg, 2 m/s, wireless charging). Discovery note of an 'Industrial' 250 kg variant maps to iggyRob Home. max_speed_ms=2 is the Home/AMR figure; a third-party profile lists 2 km/h (0.56 m/s). payload_total_kg=4 is arithmetic (2x2 kg), not vendor-stated.
